server_url.label: Immich server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your Immich server, e.g. https://photos.example.com (without /api). Requires Immich v3.2 or newer.

api_key_file.label: API key file
api_key_file.description: File containing an Immich API key (read-only permissions are enough: asset.read, asset.view, album.read, person.read, tag.read, memory.read). Preferred over the plain setting below.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: Immich API key stored in plain text in your Noctalia config. Ignored when an API key file is set.

albums.label: Albums
albums.description: Album names (exact) or IDs to include. Add ":<folder>" to send matches to another folder, e.g. "Holidays:~/Pictures/Immich/eDP-1".

people.label: People
people.description: Person names (exact) or IDs to include. Add ":<folder>" to send matches to another folder, e.g. "Holidays:~/Pictures/Immich/eDP-1".

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tag paths to include, e.g. Vacation or Travel/Europe (case-sensitive). Add ":<folder>" to send matches to another folder, e.g. "Holidays:~/Pictures/Immich/eDP-1".

show_favorites.label: Include favorites
show_favorites.description: Include favorited photos. Albums, people, tags and favorites add up; with none set, the whole library is used.

show_memories.label: Include memories
show_memories.description: Include today's Immich memories. With no albums, people, tags or favorites set, only memories are shown.

excluded_albums.label: Excluded albums
excluded_albums.description: Album names (exact) or IDs whose photos are never shown.

images_from_days.label: Only the last N days
images_from_days.description: Only photos taken in the last N days. 0 disables this. Ignored when a start date is set.

images_from_date.label: Taken on or after
images_from_date.description: Only photos taken on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

images_until_date.label: Taken on or before
images_until_date.description: Only photos taken on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

rating.label: Minimum rating
rating.description: Only photos with at least this many stars. 0 disables this.

cache_size.label: Photos in the folder
cache_size.description: How many Immich photos are kept in each photo folder for Noctalia's rotation to choose from.

folder.label: Photo folder
folder.description: Main photo folder, for entries without a ":<folder>" suffix, favorites and memories. Empty uses an "immich" folder inside your wallpaper folder. Point Settings → Wallpaper at it and turn on Automatic Rotation.

churn_minutes.label: Swap in a new photo every (minutes)
churn_minutes.description: Replaces the oldest photo in the folder with a new random one from your selection, so the folder slowly walks through it.

landscape_only.label: Landscape photos only
landscape_only.description: Only save landscape photos. Portrait photos already in a folder are removed once they're off screen.

photo_date_format.label: Photo date format
photo_date_format.description: strftime format for the photo date in the caption.

image_size.label: Image size
image_size.description: Preview: Immich's generated preview (fast, small; resolution set in Immich's Image Settings). Full size: Immich's full-resolution image. Original: the uploaded file; RAW and other formats Noctalia can't show fall back to full size. Full size and original need the asset.download permission; HEIC/AVIF need libheif.

heif_originals.label: HEIC/AVIF originals
heif_originals.description: Save HEIC, HEIF and AVIF originals as they are. Only turn on if Noctalia can load libheif (its log says "libheif.so.1 not available" otherwise); when off, those photos use Immich's full-size JPEG instead.
